text.text_excerpt: DTB is stellar! Chef Carl and his team obviously hire the best. Everyone from beginning to end was so pleasant, kind, and eager to please. The staff were attentive throughout the yelp event and willing to answer any questions. I want to make a big shout out to both Tim and John. Be sure to look for one of these two guys if you sit at the bar. Tim made my first drink the blueberry hill. He nearly talked me out of it when he said that it may not quench my sweet tooth. Nonetheless he told me he would fix it up special and made me feel assured that I would love it. Man was he right! It was certainly my favorite drink of the night. He threw in a few extra blueberries and an extra splash of sim...

New favorite! It's on the corner of oak street and if you're lucky you can find parking near by. We walked in around 8:30 and was seated quickly. This place is super cute and great for a date night or a group of friends. The kitchen was a completely open concept which I really liked. We ordered a little bit of everything. Sociales - Cauliflower Rillettes - Fried Cornbread T-Plates - Cacio e Pepe Beaucoup Plate - Stuffed Chicken - Shrimp Rice Bowl - Crispy Duck Confit (AMAZING) Other - Ice Cream Sandwich - Smothered Brussels Ahh, where do I even start? Everything was better than expected only a few dishes we could've done without. The Cauliflower Rillettes was served like a "crab dip" very...

I have been waiting to go to DTB for a long time and my boyfriend surprised me! DTB has a classy casual aesthetic. You can definitely wear jeans, or a cute dress!! We sat at the bar and Leah and max (Bradshaw??? I think there are two guys named Max) took care of us. They were awesome! Leah even made sure to get our names and told us about their brunch on the weekends. We started off with the brown butter old fashioned and the silver dollar. Both of them were great the old fashioned had a richness to it and the silver dollar was very refreshing. We decided to start of with the Mac and cheese and fried cornbread both were very good.
